title: tc-citation-sections
description:
Where a work is cited – a donut of the counts by section (Intro, Methods, Results, Discussion, Other), a legend
with letter chips, and the section under the pointer or focus named with its count and share.

counts.description: Each section's count by id: { intro: 107, methods: 13 … }; a section without one shows 0

sections.description: The sections, in order – darkest first; by default Intro, Methods, Results, Discussion and Other

source.description: A source's name shown on top; none by default

caption.description: The caption under the donut, and the legend's name

href.description: Where the details are – adds a link under the caption

openable.description: Without `href`, adds a button that fires tc-open

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

letter.description: The chip's letter; by default the label's first
